Hi Rohan / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro. We're excited to move Heliox onto Redwood for inference in Q3. Attached are our initial MSA draft and a starter Order Form (MSA is a slightly customized vendor draft). A few asks to get the intake moving: 

- Can Redwood confirm which template you'd prefer us to mirror (Redwood public MSA v1 vs Redwood Template v2)? Our legal prefers matching your baseline to avoid long back-and-forth.
- We'll need a short mutual action plan and a primary signer for the Order Form. Who should we lock in?
- Security: Heliox will need to confirm SOC 2 evidence and a sample SLA; can we route the evidence request to your security contact or attach to this thread?
- Timing: we'd like to complete commercial redlines within 5 business days if possible. Let us know realistic turnaround.

I've attached: Heliox_MSA_draft.pdf and Heliox_OrderForm_v1.xlsx.

Thanks — Lydia
Lydia Chen

Lydia / Rohan — looping in Marissa for billing and signature routing. A couple of clarifying questions before we do a tracked redline: 

1) Residency / data processing: the Heliox MSA references EU processing in §7 and a subprocessor list. Please confirm whether Heliox will require EU residency or if US-hosted inference is acceptable for the first phase. That affects our Exhibit D mapping.
2) Limits & SLA: the MSA has a 99.5% SLA request in §5. Our standard is 99.9 for dedicated capacity; we can propose 99.5 for hosted pilot. Tell us which product for pilot (hosted API vs dedicated pool).
3) Order Form: we need a definitive seat count and expected tokens/day for the first 90 days to size capacity/billing.

Deliverables and timeline: Redwood legal will provide a tracked-redline (Word) to Heliox by Tue EOD (2025-06-17). Operations will prepare a signer matrix and initial invoice estimate by next Friday (2025-06-20). If Heliox can confirm residency and signer by Monday 6/16 that will keep the timeline.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
